entries.name: Lateral Raise - With Bands
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, front view. The band is stood on at its middle and an end runs to each hand, so it lengthens as the arms rise. One fixed slight elbow bend, arms finish just above level with the floor, a pause at the top, and a lowering slower than the raise. Trunk and legs stay still.
entries.summary: Stand on the band and raise both arms out to the sides to just above level, pause, then lower slowly.

frames.caption: Stand on the middle of the band and hold an end in each hand at the sides of the thighs, back tall.
With a slight, fixed bend in the elbows, raise the arms out to the sides.
Raise until the arms are just above level with the floor.
Pause at the top with the torso still.
Lower slowly against the band to the start.
